description: This file defines the OutputChannelInterceptor class, which extends StepExecutionInterceptor and overrides the preSend method to wrap a Message's payload with a ContextualMessage containing thread context information.

classes.name: OutputChannelInterceptor
classes.description: A Spring Batch message channel interceptor that wraps outgoing messages with contextual information including thread-local data.

methods.name: preSend
methods.description: Overrides the preSend method to intercept the message, extract the step execution request, set up a contextual message with thread context, and return a new wrapped message.
